parsed.explanation: The division combines unremedied universal-exposure rules with active criminal exposure: the 2026 women's safety act mandates birth-sex facilities, shelter exclusion and birth-sex prison placement for every trans visitor; a 2019 statute defines identity-congruent bathroom use as indecent exposure; the enforceable 2023 drag/performance ban survived appeal and carries jail and felony terms; and identity documents are effectively closed at state level. The killing rate for trans women (7.8/100k, an undercount floor) exceeds the general national homicide rate, and the record documents police and officials turning a blind eye, with no gender-identity hate-crime coverage and a usable panic defence. The national parent layer adds passport-marker restriction, visa fraud scrutiny of trans applicants and documented abusive detention. Some national protections (marriage, employment ruling) are climate signals only, and several enforcement questions are open — but the operative exposures are state-imposed, current, and remedy-free. This sits at the upper edge of high risk, above 0.25-D only marginally and below the 0.45 tier because a full facility/criminalisation stack plus elevated violence lacks any documented recourse.
